name: EPIC 251587340

text.card: A red giant 1,168 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 1.00 solar masses and 14.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,362 K at its surface.
